topic: Which power allocation algorithms maximize network throughput for entangled photon pair distribution across dynamic optical inter-satellite links?
response: To maximize network throughput for entangled photon pair distribution across dynamic optical inter-satellite links, power allocation algorithms such as Joint Power and Carrier Allocation (JPCA) [1] or Energy Efficient Power Allocation (EEPA) [2] can be employed. These algorithms optimize power allocation based on traffic demands and channel conditions to minimize interference and maximize signal-to-noise ratio.
reference_context: The context mentions the use of optical satellite communications for quantum key distribution (QKD), where stable optical links are required to meet a minimum quantum bit error rate (qber). The importance of transmit and receive processing, as well as constraints on size, power, and computational power, is also highlighted.
